task_completion.description: Open the human_insulin_gene.gb file in UGENE
task_completion.visual_evidence: The UGENE interface shows 'human_insulin_gene.gb' loaded in the Project View or Sequence View.

task_completion.description: Configure the 'Find Inverted Repeats' tool with minimum length 8 and 100% identity
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Find Inverted Repeats' dialog box is visible with 'Minimum length' set to 8 and 'Identity' or 'Mismatches' set to 100% or 0 respectively.

task_completion.description: Run the search and identify repeat features on the sequence
task_completion.visual_evidence: The sequence view shows multiple 'inverted_repeat' annotations or a list of results in the 'Annotations' or 'Search Results' panel.

task_completion.description: Export the identified repeat annotations to inverted_repeats.gff
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Export' or 'Save' dialog shows the file path '~/UGENE_Data/repeat_analysis/inverted_repeats.gff' and the GFF format selected.

task_completion.description: Create a summary.txt file with the total count and coordinates of the first repeat
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal view shows 'summary.txt' containing a total count of features and the start/end coordinates of the first repeat.

integrity.description: The agent used the UGENE GUI to perform the analysis rather than just writing files via terminal
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the UGENE application window, menus, and dialog boxes being interacted with.

integrity.description: The repeat features found match the sequence data provided
integrity.visual_evidence: The annotations in the GFF or summary file correspond to the sequence length (465 bp) and the search parameters (length >= 8).

integrity.description: The agent did not simply copy a pre-existing result file
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen navigating the UGENE 'Find Inverted Repeats' workflow and manually typing or saving the summary file.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The input file is human_insulin_gene.gb (465 bp). The agent must find inverted repeats with length >= 8 and 100% identity. Expected results should include approximately 6 or more repeat pairs (e.g., CCCTCCAG/CTGGAGGG). The summary.txt must contain the total count of these features and the specific start/end coordinates of the very first feature listed in the GFF.
